summary: Indiana County, PA steel Aermotor fire tower erected 1921 with Walter Sherwin as towerman; register says removed 1990; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor tower; a 1921 notice described it as an observation tower 47 feet high
facts.status_note: Register records the tower as removed in 1990; no source describes what remains at the site

staffing.status: Walter Sherwin appointed towerman in 1921; a 1925 notice says he would man the tower as fire warden

facts.agency: The state, as the 1921 newspaper notice put it; no agency named

events.note: Erected by the state on Walter Sherwin's property; completed the week of October 11, 1921
Walter Sherwin appointed towerman at Glen Campbell fire tower
A March 30, 1922 notice says the tower had been placed in operation
Indiana Evening Gazette notice of October 7, 1925: tower to be manned by Fire Warden Walter Sherwin
Register records the tower as removed
Registered September 16, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

notes_for_editor: The brief's record holds up: gone, registered September 16, 2008, elevation 605 m. The 1990 removal date comes from the register alone, and no source describes the site today or whether it is public, so facts.access and visit are left out. The 1921-1925 history is quoted from newspaper notices as transcribed on the Forest Lookouts page, which credits the Indiana Progress, Indiana Evening Gazette and Indiana Weekly Messenger; the originals were not read. The 47-foot figure comes from a September 1921 pre-construction notice, not a measurement, and height_m is converted from it. Used about 8 page reads and 2 searches, over the per-tower read budget, because the Forest Lookouts page is long and navigation-heavy.
